# 📢 NH Reader v0.8.0 — Browse Pivot, Reader Polish & Native Documentation

**Release Date:** 2026-10-28  
**Tag:** [`v0.8.0`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/nh-reader/releases/tag/v0.8.0)

NH Reader v0.8.0 is a major user experience release delivering a refreshed browsing workflow, legibility improvements in the reader view, origin-aware "Up" navigation, full internationalization parity across 17 languages, and an extensive local documentation library!

---

## 🌟 What's New in v0.8.0

### 🧭 Unified Browse Tab & Random Doujin
- **Browse Tab**: Replaces the former "Latest" tab with a compass icon and direct access to catalog sorting: Newest, Popular All Time, Popular This Week, and Popular Today.
- **Random Doujinshi**: Jump to random works directly from the Browse toolbar with automated blacklist protection.
- **Route Consolidation**: Legacy `/popular` routes now seamlessly redirect to `/?sort=popular`.

### 📖 Reader View Polish & Content Containment
- **Gradient Removal**: Cleared the top overlay gradient so page artwork and text are crisp and legible.
- **Window Boundary Containment**: Positioned the reader viewport cleanly below the app title bar, keeping window drag and control buttons always visible.
- **Distraction-Free Reading**: The bottom navigation dock now auto-hides while reading.

### 🔙 Intelligent Details Navigation
- **Actions Row Back Button**: Integrated the back button directly into the details page action row, matching adjacent button chips.
- **Origin-Listing Memory**: Returning "Up" takes you directly back to where you entered from (Browse, Search results, Favorites, or Downloads), preserving your exact page, query, and scroll position.
- **Restored Frame Padding**: Outer container padding is restored to prevent content from clipping window borders.

### 📚 New Local Documentation Suite
- Fully comprehensive `docs/` folder containing 11 User Guides and 10 Developer Guides directly inside the repository.
- Replaces retired external wiki links with native, offline-accessible documentation.

### 🌐 100% Internationalization Parity
- Added 13 new translation keys across all 17 supported community language packs, achieving 100% key parity (292 keys).

---

## 💾 Downloads & Packages

Prebuilt desktop release packages are built for Windows, macOS, and Linux:
- **Windows**: `nh-reader-0.8.0-x64-setup.exe` & `nh-reader_0.8.0_x64_en-US.msi`
- **macOS**: `nh-reader_0.8.0_universal.dmg`
- **Linux**: `nh-reader_0.8.0_amd64.deb` & `nh-reader_0.8.0_amd64.AppImage`
